did: Fixed the phone hammering home while away (#2928). Off the home network, every try waited ten seconds, the background sends retried about every ten seconds, and each try was logged as its own failure. Now away from home is one state: logged once, and the phone tries once every 30 seconds, then waits longer each time, up to every ten minutes. A network change, a pull or Send now tries at once, and anything you ask for still goes. The marks say "Away from home since …", nothing waiting is dropped, and Game day's live socket waits for the same hold. It is promise AW1. Six rounds of independent review shaped it; most of what they caught was in when a background send is asked again.

calls.title: How the phone waits while away from home
options: hold 30 s doubling to 10 minutes, taps still go, one log line a stretch
a fixed hold (say 5 minutes) for everything, taps held too
stop trying until the network changes or the app comes back to the front
calls.why: The phone can't tell being off the home network from home being down, and Android's WebView doesn't announce a switch from mobile data to home Wi-Fi, so the hold decides how soon waiting work goes once you're home; a tap or a pull never waits (C250).
calls.undo: Change holdMs, FIRST_HOLD_MS and LONGEST_HOLD_MS in apps/www/src/lib/home-link/away.ts.

left: No test drives a background send that goes straight on into the next run during a stretch away; what the fix prevents is one extra run that sends nothing.
Studio Renders' timed read stops after home gives no answer, and a pull or Try again starts it again; it also stops on a fault on the phone that looks like silence.
